title: The Foreman's Favour
text: The foreman needs a Lumidium survey done and his crew patched up. Find him by the teleporter.

steps.goal: Talk to Foreman Petram Solidus by the teleporter.
Find Lapis Viridi by the bank and ask her to come along.
Take Lapis to the beacon at the survey site.
Bring the foreman 2 HP Gels for his crew.

endings.text: The crew used Lapis's readings to strike a rich seam before anyone else. Petram Solidus won't forget who brought them.
The survey office filed Lapis's readings. The foreman grumbled about paperwork, but he paid.
